title: Outlet Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.
  
  
Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Business Performance**

* Plan for outlet budget and review forecast on revenue and expenditure on monthly basic
* Analyze and submit month-end reports and identify deviation from business plan goals
* Participate in management meetings to review progress towards achievement of business plan goals and develop the annual business plan related for the outlet
* Plan, implement and measure profit enhancement programs by working with the kitchen &Marketing Department. Prepare & submit post-mortem promotion report to F&B Manager upon completion of promotion
* Implement and maintain control measures to ensure that food &beverage costs, productivity, labour costs and operating supply costs for the outlet is in line with budget

**Outlet Operation**

* Conduct departmental daily briefings to ensure that all pertinent information is well received by team members
* Supervise team members to ensure that all tasks assigned/required in the outlet are carried out on time and according to instruction and departmental standards
* Build a good relationship with guests or regular patrons.Try to remember individual patron’s names and their preferences to extend a personalized service
* Handle guests’ complaints and comments tactfully and efficiently
* Handle all administration work pertaining to cashier/bar operation requirement and company’s policies
* Maintain department communication logbook and updated notice board
* Check the supply of equipment/stock level and ensure that there is no shortage of items which have impact on the operation and guests
* Check the outlet/back of the house cleanliness to ensure that it is in compliant with F&B sanitation and hygiene rules and regulations
* Maintain complete knowledge of all food & beverage services, contents &preparation methods, outlets and hotel services/features
* Ensure that health, safety and security procedures are in place in the outlet
* Attend all briefings, meetings and trainings as assigned by management
* Perform proper handover and communication to the next shift
* Assist other food & beverage outlets with their operations during peak times or when required

**Qualifications**

* Hotel Management graduate or equivalent
* Additional certification(s) in Food & Beverage will be an advantage
* Good reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
* Ability to speak other languages and basic understanding of local languages will be an advantage
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in a similar capacity
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, & PowerPoint
* High degree of professionalism with sound human resources management and business acumen capabilities

Additional Information
  
  

* Strong knowledge of hotel reservation systems (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), channel management, and online travel agency (OTA) platforms.
* Good understanding of revenue management principles, room inventory control, yield management, upselling, and forecasting.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, leadership, and team management skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and hotel reservation reporting tools.
* Ability to handle guest inquiries, special requests, and escalated concerns professionally while maintaining high service standards.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English; knowledge of additional languages will be an advantage.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences and achieving departmental revenue targets.

title: AM - Reservations
description:
**Company Description**
Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.
  
  
Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Oversee the daily operations of the reservations department, ensuring exceptional, friendly, and engaging service at every guest touchpoint.
* Lead, coach, and motivate the reservations team to achieve departmental objectives, service standards, and performance targets.
* Maximize room revenue through effective upselling, cross-selling, yield management, and implementation of revenue optimization strategies in coordination with the Revenue Management team.
* Monitor room availability, occupancy, booking patterns, reservation pace, and cancellation trends to support business performance and revenue growth.
* Ensure all reservation requests, group bookings, rooming lists, amendments, and cancellations are handled accurately and efficiently in accordance with established procedures.
* Review reservations, guest profiles, special requests, and booking information to ensure accuracy and enhance the overall guest experience.
* Collaborate closely with Front Office, Sales, Revenue Management, and other departments to ensure seamless communication and smooth operational coordination.
* Handle guest inquiries, special requests, and reservation-related concerns professionally, ensuring timely resolution and high levels of guest satisfaction.
* Monitor reservations performance, prepare operational reports, and identify opportunities to improve productivity, service quality, and revenue generation.
* Ensure compliance with brand standards, hotel policies, standard operating procedures, and data confidentiality requirements.
* Support the implementation of reservations strategies, systems, and processes to enhance operational efficiency and achieve departmental goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality, Tourism, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in hotel reservations, preferably with a luxury or upscale hotel brand, including at least 1–2 years in a supervisory or team leadership role.

Additional Information
  
  

* Strong knowledge of hotel reservation systems (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), channel management, and online travel agency (OTA) platforms.
* Good understanding of revenue management principles, room inventory control, yield management, upselling, and forecasting.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, leadership, and team management skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and hotel reservation reporting tools.
* Ability to handle guest inquiries, special requests, and escalated concerns professionally while maintaining high service standards.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English; knowledge of additional languages will be an advantage.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences and achieving departmental revenue targets.

title: Deputy General Manager - APS
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a seasoned Operational Excellence and Industrial Engineering leader responsible for driving Lean Manufacturing, APS, and IE strategies across TND sites.
  
  
The role focuses on establishing a strong Lean culture, enabling process excellence, and leading transformation initiatives aligned with global standards and Industry 4.0.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Lean & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Drive Lean Manufacturing strategies across TND sites
* Implement Lean methodologies (5S, TPM, VSM, Kanban, etc.)
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives and workshops (OPL, line balancing, visual management, etc.)
* Identify and eliminate waste across processes
* Improve operational performance and sustain Lean culture

Industrial Engineering
  
  

* Support plants in applying IE principles and standards
* Drive capacity planning and new product / process launches
* Develop line concepts, layouts, and footprint optimization
* Manage capex planning, approvals, and realization
* Oversee automation and digitization initiatives

APS & Strategy Deployment
  
  

* Act as SPOC for TND in global APS/IE initiatives
* Define and deploy APS standards and best practices
* Mentor APS/IE managers and plant teams
* Ensure compliance with reporting and policy deployment

Leadership & Capability Building
  
  

* Mentor and develop teams across plants
* Lead cross-functional workshops and improvement projects
* Build a strong culture of learning and collaboration

Deliverables
  
  

* Implementation of Lean culture across plants
* Achievement of TND scorecard targets
* Cost savings aligned with budget
* Successful new product and process launches
* Improved efficiency and capacity utilization
* Effective capex execution and project delivery
* Progress toward Industry 4.0 and paperless operations

**Experience & Skills**

* 20+ years of experience in Operational Excellence / Lean Manufacturing
* Strong expertise in IE, Lean, TPS, and manufacturing systems
* Experience in automotive or auto ancillary industry preferred
* Exposure to automation, digitization, and Industry 4.0
* Strong leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities

Education & Certifications
  
  

* BE / B.Tech in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering (preferred)
* Lean certification from a reputed institute
* Six Sigma Green Belt certification
* Strong proficiency in MS Office tools
* Knowledge of Industry 4.0 concepts

Competencies
  
  
Behavioral
  
  

* Take ownership
* Add value
* Collaborate
* Make it easy
* Be curious

Functional
  
  

* Leadership and decision making
* Analytical thinking
* Influencing stakeholders
* Execution excellence
* Conceptual and innovative thinking

Personal Characteristics
  
  

* Strong shop-floor orientation and Gemba mindset
* Ability to engage and train teams from operators to management
* Hands-on problem-solving approach
* Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills
* Passion for continuous learning and technology adoption
* Strong team leadership capabilities

Languages
  
  

* English
* Kannada
* Hindi

title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
Diploma / BE / B-Tech (Electronic / Mechatronics / Mechanical)
  
  
**Qualifications**
The Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily manufacturing operations, ensuring production targets are achieved while maintaining quality, safety, and efficiency standards. This role involves supervising production personnel, coordinating resources, monitoring workflows, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to support operational excellence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Production Management
  
  

* Supervise and coordinate daily production activities.
* Ensure production schedules are met according to customer and business requirements.
* Monitor line performance, productivity, and resource utilization.
* Minimize downtime and resolve production issues promptly.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, coach, and motivate production operators and technicians.
* Assign work duties and monitor employee performance.
* Conduct shift handovers and team meetings.
* Support employee training and skill development.

Quality Assurance
  
  

* Ensure compliance with quality standards and work instructions.
* Monitor process adherence and product quality.
* Coordinate corrective and preventive actions for quality issues.
* Support audits and continuous improvement activities.

Safety & Compliance
  
  

* Enforce workplace safety policies and procedures.
* Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments.
* Ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.
* Promote a culture of safety awareness.

Process Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities for productivity and efficiency improvements.
* Support Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Analyze production data and implement corrective actions.
* Work closely with engineering, maintenance, and quality teams.

Inventory & Material Management
  
  

* Ensure material availability for uninterrupted production.
* Monitor WIP (Work-In-Process) levels.
* Coordinate with planning and warehouse teams.
* Reduce material waste and improve inventory accuracy.

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electronics, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related Engineering discipline.
* 3-8 years of manufacturing or production experience.
* Minimum 1-2 years of supervisory experience preferred.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes and production control systems.

**Required Skills**

* Leadership and team management
* Production planning and scheduling
* Problem-solving and root cause analysis
* Quality management systems
* Lean Manufacturing and 5S
* MS Excel, ERP/MRP systems
* Communication and interpersonal skills
* Time management and decision-making

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

* Production output achievement
* On-time delivery performance
* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Scrap and rework reduction
* Labor productivity
* Safety compliance
* Downtime reduction
* Attendance and workforce utilization

Reporting Structure
  
  

* Reports To: Production Manager / Operations Manager
* Supervises: Operators, Assemblers, Technicians, and Line Leaders

For your background as a
**Production Engineer in manufacturing operations**
, emphasizing
**SMT, coating processes, quality control, process improvement, traceability, and production efficiency**
on your resume will align well with a Production Supervisor role.
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Manufacturing related technologies, systems, infrastructures, standards and processes - Advanced
* Lean Production principles, methods and tools (e.g., SW, LSW, Jishuken, LIB, TPM, 5S) - Advanced
* Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions (please refer to respective standards) - Advanced
* Product Knowledge (Functionalities and Applications) - Advanced
* Logistics Management (including Logistics policies, systems and processes, e.g. production scheduling) - Advanced
* Quality Management (including Quality policies, systems and processes e.g., Jidoka /Poke Yoke/ Problem Solving) - Advanced
* Leadership skills, tools and techniques (Time Management, Discipline, Motivation) - Advanced
* ESH - Advanced
* English, language skills (depending on the plant perspective) – Basics
* KPIs (OEE, FPY, Scrap) - Advanced

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. Make it yours!
**Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.**
